arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. A gassy smell should always be treated as urgent, so please do this now: don't use the oven, any switches, lighters or flames. Open windows and doors, and leave the flat. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If anyone feels unwell or you are in immediate danger, call 999. We are sending a Gas Safe engineer request and have alerted our team and your landlord. Please don't go back in until the gas engineer says it is safe. We will update you as soon as we have more details.
